description: Update an existing contact: names, email, membership level/status, or custom field values. Only the fields you pass are sent. Wild Apricot: PUT /accounts/{accountId}/contacts/{contactId}.

email.description: Primary email — must be unique in the account.

field_values.description: Custom/common field values to set. Only include fields you want to change.

FieldName.description: Field title as shown in Wild Apricot.

SystemCode.description: Field system code (stable even if the title is renamed), from wildapricot_list_contact_fields.

Value.description: The value: string / number / boolean / ISO date, or {Id, Label} for a choice field, or an array of those for multi-choice.

membership_enabled.description: true to make the contact a member (also set membership_level_id).

membership_level_id.description: Membership level to assign, from wildapricot_list_membership_levels.

recreate_invoice.description: Whether Wild Apricot should (re)create the membership invoice. Wild Apricot's default is true.

name: wildapricot_update_contact
title: Update a contact or member
